_readme: SHARED platform repos — one instance for ALL clients, not per-customer. Per-client repos (ETL, config) live in customers/<CLIENT>/repos.json.

frontend.note: React/TS monorepo, config-driven UI (AG Grid). Same build serves every tenant; behavior differs by config, not code.

backend.note: Java (Maven). Executes pivots, serves config, builds filter options, member resolution. See knowledge/backend/darwin-primer.md.
